basic_details.job_title: Civil Court Muzaffarpur Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 3 Stenographer, Clerk and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Retired employees of the Civil Courts can apply for 3 contractual support-staff posts in the Evening Court, Muzaffarpur: 1 Stenographer, 1 Clerk and 1 Peon/ Orderly. The Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Muzaffarpur has invited the applications under Memo No. 7466-7505/E dated 17 November 2026. Applications must reach the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Patna on or before 16 December 2026, either personally or through registered post.

content_sections.heading: About Muzaffarpur Civil Court Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Muzaffarpur, Bihar, for engaging support staff in the Evening Court of Muzaffarpur Judgeship. The engagement is governed by the guidelines and directions of the Hon'ble High Court, Patna. The notice has been forwarded to all the Principal District & Sessions Judges of Bihar to be published on the notice boards of their judgeships.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must reach the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Patna on or before 16 December 2026. They can be handed in personally or sent through registered post. Late receipt is not covered by the notice, as the application must reach the office by that date. The notice does not prescribe an application form, an envelope superscription or a list of enclosures. It also prints no street address or PIN code for the receiving office.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The applicant must be a retired employee of the Civil Courts. Only retired court employees who have retired within the last three years, prior to the period as per guidelines issued by the Hon'ble High Court, Patna, can apply. The applicant must be physically and mentally fit to discharge the duties assigned to the respective post. The applicant must possess satisfactory service records and should not have been subjected to any major disciplinary punishment during service. The notice does not mention an educational qualification or an age limit for these posts. Candidates should check the official notification for the post-specific eligibility of each post. The engagement shall be purely contractual in nature and can be terminated at any time, as per the directions of the Hon'ble High Court Patna. The period of engagement, remuneration and other conditions shall be governed by the applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority. The engagement shall not confer any right to claim regular appointment or continuation in service. The selected candidates shall be required to perform their duties for a minimum of 05 hours on each working day.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Muzaffarpur Civil Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 posts in the Evening Court, Muzaffarpur: 1 Stenographer, 1 Clerk and 1 Peon/ Orderly.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Patna on or before 16 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the Muzaffarpur Evening Court posts?
faq.answer: Only retired employees of the Civil Courts who retired within the last three years, as per guidelines of the Hon'ble High Court, Patna, can apply. They must have satisfactory service records and no major disciplinary punishment during service.

faq.question: Q4. What is required for the Stenographer post?
faq.answer: The applicant must have the requisite experience and proficiency in shorthand and typing, besides being a retired Civil Court employee.

faq.question: Q5. What is required for the Clerk post?
faq.answer: The applicant must have adequate knowledge and experience of clerical and judicial office work.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Submit the application personally or send it through registered post so that it reaches the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Patna on or before 16 December 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely contractual, can be terminated at any time as per the directions of the Hon'ble High Court Patna, and gives no right to claim regular appointment or continuation in service.

faq.question: Q8. What are the working hours?
faq.answer: The selected candidates must perform their duties for a minimum of 05 hours on each working day.

faq.question: Q9. How is the remuneration decided?
faq.answer: The period of engagement, remuneration and other conditions are governed by the applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority.
